summary: Iteration 15: all requested features PASS. Backend 14/14 (+1 skipped: no city-hidden product exists to test exclusion). Register requires name (422 missing/empty), /auth/me returns+updates name (stripped), admin PUT/POST accept name, Patrik has name 'Patrik'. POST /api/credits/estimate: 401 without auth, {enabled:false,credits:0} when disabled, floor(sum(price*qty)/100) when enabled (verified vs DB prices, 1899 kr x1=18, x2=37), no price fields in response, empty/unknown part -> 0, qty 0/1000 -> 422. Frontend (375x667): register shows 'Ange ditt namn' + 'Välj ort' errors, city picker under 'Din butik' works, after register home shows 'VÄLKOMMEN <NAME>' + 'Du handlar nu från butiken i Borås' (centered), no 'Inloggad som'. Cart: cart-credits-estimate shows 18 -> 37 on quantity +1, hidden when credits disabled, no prices shown; cart-item-name and cart-item-open open /product/44062513?color=8953 with that colour selected. Profile edit (in-app nav) prefills+saves name, home updates; empty name falls back to company. Admin user page user-name-input saves & persists; new-user-name-input present. Admin w/o city: no store pill (expected). No deprecated Expo packages in touched files.

minor.issue: Whitespace-only name ('   ') passes min_length=1 and is stored as '' (200). Validate after strip.
name defaults to '' and can be cleared, although register requires it (home falls back to company, so not breaking).
Search matches only email/company, not name.

ui_bugs.issue: Form state initialised once via useState from user; on web refresh/deep link to /account/edit the user is still loading, so all fields (name, company, phone) are empty and Save fails with 'Företag är obligatoriskt'. Pre-existing; in-app navigation works. Fix: init in useEffect when user arrives or gate render on auth loading.

issues: User name is not shown in the admin users list rows or on the Profile card (only company/email) – consider showing it.
Profile 'Redigera uppgifter' subtitle doesn't mention namn.

action_items: Strip-then-validate name on register (reject whitespace-only); strip name in admin PUT.
account/edit.tsx: sync form state when user loads (useEffect) to fix empty form on web refresh/deep link.
Optional: show name in admin users list + include name in admin users search; show name on Profile card.
Older regression tests (test_iter10..14, test_blaklader_api etc.) register customers without 'name' and will now fail with 422 – add name to their payloads.
critical_code_review_comments: credits.py estimate: uses customer_city_filter so hidden products count 0 – consistent with order rules; returns only credit total – OK.
cart.tsx: queryKey includes part_no:qty, placeholderData keeps old value during refetch – no flicker; estimate only fetched when credits enabled.
index.tsx: hero alignItems center + textAlign center; store pill text align start but pill itself centered – visually fine.
seed_data_creation: Pytest creates TEST_T15 users (cleaned in teardown). UI test registered test+t15ui1@example.com (TEST_T15UI Bygg, Borås), toggled credits via admin API; deleted afterwards. No orders created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iter15_name_credits_estimate.py -n 0. Product 44062513 (price 1899, colour 8953, size S) is handy for cart credit checks. Navigate to /account/edit via Profile > edit-profile-row, not via page.goto (form empty on cold load).
